description: Canonical normalized record vocabulary for the Personal Adventure Almanac. Source files may retain legacy fields; catalog.js projects them into this schema at load time.

normalizedFields.recordClass: Canonical kind: summit, race, adventure, or event.
normalizedFields.sport: Broad sport family used for cross-page grouping.
normalizedFields.finishDate: Canonical ISO finish date, equal to startDate for one-day records.
normalizedFields.distance: Object with numeric km/mi values and optional display label.
normalizedFields.locationInfo: Object containing label, region, coordinates, and precision.
normalizedFields.evidence: Object describing source text and confidence.
normalizedFields.routeInfo: Object describing route status/provenance when known.
